note: The overall percentage is a weighted estimate. Measured areas are computed by commands (see how/facts); the rest are author estimates, marked measured:false.

areas.name: Reading the game's files
areas.how: share of the game's format families we read (list below); coverage inside each family is also incomplete
facts: not read: 3D models and animations, FMOD sound banks, fonts (.fnt), recipe and vehicle scripts, other save files (map_*.bin, chunks), cell header tail, UI layout and UI textures, mod loading

areas.name: The game's Lua scripts run
areas.how: Lua files that execute without error, counted as 20% of the area weight (running is not the same as correct); the rest is the real Java API, which barely exists yet (author estimate: ~0)
facts: undefined Java names the Lua touches: 121

areas.name: World rendering
areas.how: frame similarity to the game, 1 - (diff/60), times 0.5: lighting, characters, weather and animation are not there yet
facts: frame 1 difference from the game: 15.16 of 255

areas.name: Gameplay and zombies
areas.how: author estimate: a 30 Hz step, movement and collision exist in simplified form; zombies are placeholders with invented parameters

areas.name: Saves
areas.how: author estimate: the player position is read from players.db; nothing else
facts: player position is read from a real save
time of day from map_t.bin is not decoded

areas.name: Menus, interface, settings
areas.how: author estimate: a world window and a launcher exist, the game's UI does not
